title: Start New Year by Setting Reasonable Learning Goals
summary: Дуудлагаа төрөлх хэлтэн шиг болгох албагүй, бодитой зорилго тавих нь чухал.

questions.prompt: According to Eli Hinkel, why is it hard for adults to sound exactly like a native speaker?
options: The brain loses some control over the mouth muscles
Adults do not practice speaking English enough
English sounds keep changing from year to year
questions.explain: Хинкелийн хэлснээр бие өсөж дууссаны дараа "the brain loses some of its ability to change the way it controls the muscles of the mouth" буюу тархи амны булчинг удирдах чадвараа хэсэгчлэн алддаг.

questions.prompt: What does Marla Yoshida call a reasonable goal?
options: Losing your accent in five lessons
questions.explain: "That's a reasonable goal: being understood easily" гэж хэлсэн.

questions.prompt: What does the article suggest you do first?
options: Pick one or two hard sounds to work on
Buy software that removes your accent
Stop speaking your native language at home
questions.explain: Эхлээд "Choose one or two sounds that are difficult for you to pronounce" буюу хэцүү нэг хоёр авиа сонгоод, түүнийгээ сайжруулахыг зөвлөсөн.
